person.name: Yuvan Pramesh Selvarangam
person.headline: Electronics & Communication Engineering student building embedded systems, custom PCBs and C/C++ software
person.summary: B.Tech ECE student at VIT (2023-2027, CGPA 8.74) working across embedded firmware, PCB design, robotics and systems software. Primary language is C/C++. Interests: embedded systems, cybersecurity, telecommunications/6G, and shipping complete hardware-software products.

experience.summary: Bioprinter prototype: electronics, pneumatics and firmware.
highlights: Developed electronic and pneumatic control systems for a bioprinter prototype, improving printing accuracy by 50%.
Customized the open-source Klipper firmware to support 5+ bioprinting-specific functions, integrating 4 hardware components and reducing manual control requirements by 25%.
Performed system integration, testing, calibration and troubleshooting across 50+ test cycles, achieving 80% system reliability.

projects.title: Ticket Booking System
projects.description: Full-stack ticket booking platform written in C++17 with a REST API and SQLite database.
highlights: Real-time seat holds, booking confirmation and waitlist cascading.
Hand-rolled JWT (HS256) authentication via OpenSSL, salted SHA-256 password hashing, and hashed tamper-proof waitlist tokens.
Role-based access control for Admin, Organiser and Customer roles.
10-table relational schema; atomic transactions (SQLite WAL mode) to prevent double-booking race conditions.
Containerised with Docker and deployed to Render; 4 automated test suites.

projects.title: Fully Automated Meal Maker (Nexcook)
projects.type: Client consultancy project for Mitatronics, Mumbai
projects.description: Commercial cooking automation system developed as part of a consultancy engagement.
highlights: Multi-core ESP32 control system on FreeRTOS enabling real-time parallel execution of independent kitchen modules.
Custom PCBs designed and validated in Altium Designer: schematic capture, layout, DRC, component selection and prototype bring-up.
LVGL touchscreen HMI with I2C-connected sensors and actuators for recipe execution, monitoring and safety control.
Integrated firmware, custom electronics and electromechanical subsystems with mechanical and electrical teams.

projects.title: 4-Channel TB6600HG Stepper Driver PCB
projects.type: Hardware design (part of the cooking automation system)
projects.description: 100x80mm driver board for the cooking machine with channels for Onion, Tomato, Chopper and Grinder Base.
highlights: Layer strategy, DRC rules with HighCurrent and Digital net classes, and copper pour planning.
Star-point LGND/PGND grounding to isolate noise-sensitive digital signals from motor current.

projects.title: Custom ESP32-S3 Carrier Board
projects.description: 4-layer high-speed PCB integrating ESP32, FTDI and dual USB-C interfaces.
highlights: Differential-pair routing and power distribution tuned for signal integrity and EMI performance.
Multilayer ground and power plane management with stitching vias and impedance-controlled traces.

projects.title: Autonomous Factory Patrol Drone
projects.description: Compact autonomous drone concept for indoor factory surveillance and patrol.
highlights: Mission planning and patrol trajectories simulated with PX4 SITL, Gazebo and ROS 2 on a custom factory world for the x500 quadrotor.
STM32 companion controller architecture for high-level mission control and flight-controller communication.
Waypoint navigation and emergency handling workflow.
Debugged missing IMU plugin and magnetometer mismatch (spherical coordinates block); investigating height-estimate stability under real-time-factor degradation.
